description: This file contains unit tests for the Google Cloud Pub/Sub logging callback integration within the litellm project. It tests asynchronous publishing behavior, message formatting, and request payload validation. It utilizes pytest and asyncio for testing asynchronous functions, mocks external HTTP calls, and verifies request bodies against expected JSON templates.
